_template: drumbeat.json — created by /mct:start-engagement. Defines the engagement rhythm using Loops, Checkpoints, and Phase Gates.
_model: Engagement rhythm is loop-based, not calendar-based. Three structures nest inside each phase.
_checklist_note: Checklists below are EXAMPLES. The EM defines project-specific checklists during scoping. Items can be strings (simple) or objects with status: { item: '...', status: 'done|pending|skipped' }.

loop.description: Most frequent. Delegate task → agent output → EM synthesis → hypothesis update → next task.
loop.principal_touchpoint: After each loop in standard mode. Batch across tasks where sensible.

checkpoint.description: EM synthesizes findings → presents to Principal → steering input → reprioritize.

phase_gate.description: End of each phase. All deliverables assembled → QA → Partner Review → Principal go/no-go.
phase_gate.principal_touchpoint: Required — Principal approves or requests additional work

phase_gates.name: Scope Confirmation
phase_gates.description: Scope confirmed by Principal including team composition, hypothesis tree, workstream plan

phase_gates.name: Phase 1 Gate
phase_gates.description: Fact base sufficient. Interim report QA'd and Partner-reviewed. Principal approves.

checklist.item: Hypothesis tree updated with Phase 1 evidence

phase_gates.name: Phase 2 Gate
phase_gates.description: Storyline stands, numbers verified. QA + Partner + Client Lens reviews complete.

checklist.item: Hypothesis tree updated with Phase 2 evidence

phase_gates.name: Final Gate
phase_gates.description: Partner sign-off: ready for client. Client Lens positive.
